I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the latest figure for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 100 seats.

- On Oct 14 Ilse posted 261 seats in #north-team, and I acknowledged that number there.
- The same morning she corrected it to 100 in #north-random, saying she had read the wrong line.
- Dana is in both channels, so she can see the correction herself. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it can be shared with her.
- I suggested Dana check with Ilse before entering 100 as final.

The 261 post and my reply confirming it are still uncorrected in #north-team, so anyone reading only that channel will see the wrong number.

The gbrain search didn't run because its access token isn't tied to any member. I used only the channels Dana belongs to.
